from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from pricing import format_money


def test_format_money_always_shows_two_decimals():
    assert format_money(Decimal("12.5"), "EUR") == "12.50 EUR"


def test_format_money_rounds_half_a_cent_up():
    assert format_money(Decimal("0.005"), "RON") == "0.01 RON"


def test_format_money_keeps_negative_sign():
    assert format_money(Decimal("-3"), "USD") == "-3.00 USD"


def test_format_money_rejects_lowercase_currency_code():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_money(Decimal("1"), "eur")
